_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: It always takes longer than you expect.
beats.note: Even when you take into account Hofstadter's law. Douglas Hofstadter wrote it in Godel, Escher, Bach in 1979, about chess computers.

beats.name: Buehler, Griffin and Ross
beats.role: Asked 37 psychology students to estimate how long their final year theses would take.

beats.note: The average time they actually took was 55.5 days.

beats.text: Even the gloomy guess was too short.
beats.note: When asked for a worst case, the average was 48.6 days. That still fell short of the real average.

beats.context: About this share finished in the time they had predicted.
